title: 第七章 血虹刀法第八章 炼丹
lines: 第七章血虹刀法徐义林摇头叹息，已经对柳无邪不抱任何希望，其他人更是冷笑不已。
足足一大包药材，还有一座炼丹炉，丹宝阁做事很周到，考虑的很全面。
关闭院门，平常也没什么人过来，倒是很安静。
所有药材全部倒出，堆满了整个院子，院子里面有口井，打上来一些清水，再拿来一座巨大浴桶。
没有丹火，只能找来一些枯木，点燃之后，架上炼丹炉，将这些药材丢进去。
淬体液连一品丹药都算不上，利用它浸泡身体，却有意想不到的效果，最适合打熬筋骨。
第一次炼制有些生疏，熟悉之后，手法突然加速，一股浓郁的药香，在院子上空回荡。
花费大半天时间，炼制出来一盆淬体液，倒出三分之一进入浴桶，脱光衣服，只保留一条内裤，身体钻入浴桶之中。
刺骨的疼痛，顺着毛孔扎入筋脉，清理里面的污垢。
太荒吞天诀运转起来，整个院子上空的灵气，形成一个漩涡，盘旋在柳无邪的头顶上。
吞天神鼎疯狂吸收，形成的液体，可以帮助他快速提升境界，尽早突破先天境。
筋脉传来刺痛感，其中的淤泥，顺着毛孔溢出，木桶中的清水，逐渐变成深褐色，还在不断的变化。
阵阵恶臭，从木桶里面传出。
修炼一个时辰，站起身子，每一寸骨骼，传来阵阵暴鸣，浑身舒泰，宛如给身体内部洗了一个澡。
“舒坦！”
站在院子中央，施展一套拳法，适应肉身带来的变化。
拿起毛巾，擦拭额头上的汗珠，盘膝坐下来，脑海中浮现大量的武功秘籍。
“功法已经解决了，接下来该修炼武技，前世一直用刀，今世还是走刀的路线。”
从无数本武技当中寻找，难度极大，既要适合自己，还要适合这个世界，更要适合他现在这个境界。
级别太高的武技，真气无法催动，反而伤身。
“就选你了，血虹刀法！”
刀气如虹，势如破竹，这是血虹刀法的精要所在。
一共七式，一招连着一招，刀刀致命，最快的进攻，就是最好的防守，血虹刀法攻守兼备，出刀必杀人。
从屋子里面拿出一把长刀，不是很顺手，先将就着使用，等过明天去家族兵器坊，寻找一把合适的趁手兵器。
握刀！
出刀！
握刀！
出刀！
柳无邪不断的在重复同一个动作，不知疲倦，汗水已经湿透了衣衫。
不知不觉，已经日落黄昏，大半天时间，他一直在连续做出刀跟收刀的姿势。
在他面前，摆放一根木桩，中间位置划上一个记号，开始的时候，落刀位置距离目标相差甚远。
随着时间的推移，连续出三刀，有一刀能命中目标，准确度在不断提高。
修炼血虹刀法，对刀法的准确度，要求极为苛刻，必须要一刀毙命。
肚子传来叽里咕噜的声音，早已饥肠辘辘，才想起来中午到现在还没吃东西，剧烈的饥饿感，让他放弃继续修炼，简单收拾一下，离开屋子，朝徐家饭堂走去。
平时的时候，柳无邪不喜欢跟岳父岳母一起用餐，每次都会被他们数落。
正是用餐高峰期，徐家数千口人，集中在一起，还是很壮观，分出好几个等级。
执事级别头目，分坐一片区域，较为安静。
扫地下人，划分到大门处，很是嘈杂，柳无邪用餐的地方靠近边角区域，单独开辟出来一座小包间，供应他使用。
他的出现，原本很嘈杂的饭堂，突然静下来，每个人低头吃饭，还有人露出嘲讽的眼神。
没有理会四周目光，直径走进包间，往常饭菜都会提前摆好，今天桌子上不仅没有饭菜，连他平时吃饭的桌椅，都被搬走。
“这个废物还有脸过来吃饭，换成我早就找块豆腐撞死算了。”
content_en:
Chapter 7 Blood Rainbow Sword Technique Xu Yilin shook his head and sighed. He no longer had any hope for Liu Wuxie, and the others even sneered.
There is a large bag of medicinal materials and an alchemy furnace. The Alchemy Pavilion is very thoughtful and considers everything comprehensively.
After closing the courtyard door, no one usually comes, so it is very quiet.
All the medicinal materials were poured out and piled up in the entire yard. There was a well in the yard, and some clean water was brought in, and a huge bathtub was brought.
There was no alchemy fire, so we could only find some dead wood. After lighting it, we set up an alchemy furnace and threw these medicinal materials in.
The body quenching liquid is not even a first-grade elixir. Using it to soak the body has unexpected effects. It is most suitable for strengthening the muscles and bones.
The first refining was a little unfamiliar, but after getting familiar with it, the technique suddenly accelerated, and a strong medicinal fragrance echoed over the courtyard.
It took most of a day to refine a basin of body quenching fluid, pour a third of it into the tub, strip off all clothes except for a pair of underwear, and get into the tub.
The bone-piercing pain penetrates the veins along the pores, cleaning out the dirt inside.
When the Taihuang Heaven Swallowing Technique was activated, the aura above the entire courtyard formed a vortex, hovering above Liu Wuxie's head.
The liquid absorbed by the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Cauldron can help him quickly improve his realm and break through the innate realm as soon as possible.
There was a tingling sensation in the veins, and the silt in it overflowed along the pores. The clear water in the barrel gradually turned dark brown and was still changing.
Waves of stench came from inside the barrel.
After practicing for an hour, I stood up, and every inch of my bones felt violent roars. I felt so comfortable all over, as if I had taken a bath inside my body.
"Comfortable!"
Standing in the middle of the courtyard, he performed a set of boxing techniques to adapt to the changes brought about by his physical body.
Picking up the towel, wiping the sweat on his forehead, he sat down cross-legged, with a large number of martial arts secrets in his mind.
"The skills have been solved. Next, it's time to practice martial arts. I have always used swords in my previous life, but I still follow the path of swords in this life."
It is extremely difficult to find one among countless martial arts. It must be suitable for himself, the world, and his current state.
Martial skills that are too high-level cannot be activated by the true energy, but will harm the body.
"The choice is yours, Blood Rainbow Sword Technique!"
The energy of the sword is like a rainbow, and its power is like breaking bamboo. This is the essence of the Blood Rainbow Sword Technique.
There are seven moves in total, one move after another, the sword is deadly, the fastest attack is the best defense, the Blood Rainbow Sword Technique is both offensive and defensive, and the sword will kill people.
I took out a long knife from the house. It was not very easy to use. I will use it for now and wait until tomorrow to go to the family weapons shop to find a suitable weapon.
Hold the knife!
Draw the knife!
Hold the knife!
Draw the knife!
Liu Wuxie kept repeating the same action tirelessly, and her clothes were soaked with sweat.
Before he knew it, it was already sunset, and for most of the day, he had been making the gesture of holding the knife back.
In front of him, place a wooden stake with a mark in the middle. At the beginning, the position where the knife falls is far from the target.
As time goes by, if three swords are fired in a row, one of them can hit the target, and the accuracy is constantly improving.
To practice the Blood Rainbow Sword Technique, the accuracy of the sword technique is extremely demanding, and one must kill with one blow.
There was a growling sound in his stomach, and he was already hungry. Then he remembered that he hadn't eaten anything until noon. The intense hunger made him give up on practicing. He simply packed up, left the house, and walked towards the Xu family dining hall.
Normally, Liu Wuxie didn't like to dine with his father-in-law and mother-in-law, and would be scolded by them every time.
It was the peak dining period, and thousands of people from the Xu family gathered together. It was still a spectacular sight, divided into several levels.
The deacon-level bosses sit in a separate area, which is relatively quiet.
Sweeping the underground people, it was divided into the gate, which was very noisy. The place where Liu Wuxie ate was close to the corner area, and a small private room was opened for him to use.
With his appearance, the originally noisy dining hall suddenly became quiet. Everyone lowered their heads to eat, and some people showed mocking eyes.
Ignoring the glances from around him, Diao walked into the private room. Usually, the food would be laid out in advance. Today, not only was there no food on the table, but even the tables and chairs where he usually ate had been moved away.
"This loser still has the nerve to come over to eat. If it had been for me, I would have killed him with a piece of tofu."
